## Components, summons and ongoing effects

**V** requires audible speech; **S** requires a free hand or a class feature expressly permitting the gesture; **F** is the class's ordinary casting focus. Core's M/F shorthand is interpreted here as the existing focus alternative. No unspecified costly or consumed material is added. These hand/focus conventions are provisional and may require equipment integration. A spell with V is blocked by an effect explicitly preventing verbal casting.

Summon stat blocks use their printed AC/HP/attack die. Where absent, saves use the owner's PB, other ability checks use +0, walking Speed is 30 feet, and there are no unstated creature immunities or extraordinary senses. Unless a card explicitly gives another bounded range, a commanded companion must be within 60 feet and able to perceive its owner. All one owner's companions share one Bonus Action command and **one damaging action total per round**. Without a command they move and Dodge. A replacement requires the full casting cost. No summon grants loot, a reusable corpse or resource-generating death trigger.

The [rank-2 Conjuration review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_RANK2_EXACT_REVIEW.md) approves this specific companion overlay: **when an exact companion source prints multiple attacks as one damaging action, those attacks are components of one commanded offensive action and consume the owner's single offensive-companion allowance unless that source expressly grants otherwise.** Summon Air Pet explicitly makes its two source attacks within that one action; no second command/action or remaining offense for another companion is created. Its fixed AC15/HP20/two 1d6 attacks do not inherit generic companion scaling.

Planar Ally (Minor) uses a finite NEW summon-only profile for the source's intended CR-1 role. The bounded public bestiary scan did not establish an eligible published exact-CR1 extraplanar creature; this card does not certify its CR or rewrite a bestiary entry. Summon Weaponry Satchel has finite conjured contents tied to one duration, with a narrow exception only for an already resolving immediate use. Alignment Weapon's suppression default applies only to that printed card.

Resonance Well rolls one 1d4 total reserve. Its separately named creation and receipt uses commit before prevention and reset only through each character's beneficial long rest. These limits neither share nor reset Kindle or Mod Rod records. Read the exact cards and [rank-2 status](CONJURATION_RANK2_REVIEW_STATUS.json); pricing/schema checks do not execute these effects or certify balance.

The [rank-3 Conjuration review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_RANK3_EXACT_REVIEW.md) adds seven bounded cards. Earth Pet's knockdown is Prone, not positional movement; generic push/pull immunity does not automatically prevent it. Burst of Flamewind affects every creature the caster ordinarily classifies as an enemy at a known location in its cone, with automatic source damage and a save controlling only its push.

Elemental Displacement selects a nearby willing recipient and a perceived destination; its teleport path is not constrained by intervening terrain. Spectral Steed actually crosses planes to a known site, once per steed attempt. Its 350-pound **and** 12-Load limits count the rider's body and all gear, including melded equipment. The reviewed correction from the conference's proposed6Load avoids excluding all gear from a Medium rider; ordinary Burdened applies at6Load. Read the exact mount/command/arrival procedure; it does not close general mounted combat.

Resonance Conduit transfers already-existing RP between two separate pools, with committed deductions, gated credit, and no resource creation or daily-ledger reset. Renewed consent cannot revive an ended application, but a new legal paid cast may create a new one. Faction Portal provides actual one-way travel to a known HQ on the same or another plane. Its positive-standing predicate uses the current canonical reputation record without migrating its scale. Travel may bypass a geographic route; elapsed clocks, cargo custody, contamination, claims, arrival law and settlement remain actual procedures. These cards do not declare automatic Extraction success or invent a blanket prohibition on planar escape. [Review status](CONJURATION_RANK3_REVIEW_STATUS.json) preserves the manuscript/runtime/balance distinction.

 Noncombat helpers cannot attack or operate combat items.

A cantrip that stabilizes restores no HP and removes no Wound. Mending cannot replace finite machine repair or refresh ammunition, charges, duration or class resources. Created tools, servants and water obey the explicit card limits; a spell does not silently pay wages, produce saleable materials or erase abstract expedition Supply.

All hard whole-Action/turn denial uses one combined **source-character/target/encounter** record across that character's spells, class features and companions. Once used, later hard-denial riders from that source fail; damage and soft riders resolve as printed. Boss immunities remain effective. Same-stat flat bonuses use the strongest; same-name dice bonuses do not stack. Apply one allowed bonus-die spell per roll in this packet unless a reviewed feature explicitly permits more. Temporary HP never add together. Copies never generate copies, class procs or resource loops.

## Placement and involuntary endings

A transformation does not grant movement. A voluntary size change keeps the same spatial anchor and must fit before payment. Preserve the existing footprint on a same-size change when possible.

A mandatory ending still occurs if the root anatomy does not fit. First try its normal space at the same position, then a legal squeeze under the [movement rules](COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md). If neither fits, record a placement conflict. The **new provisional placement procedure** permits only a nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space. Choose the minimum displacement that fits the whole body; among ties, preserve the greatest overlap with its previous footprint. If still tied, the Director uses a fixed neutral board order, not a tactical choice by the affected player. If no adjacent candidate fits, the conflict remains until the obstruction is removed or a legal relocation effect resolves it. Do not search farther afield.

This mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no opportunity attack, charge distance, movement benefit or other movement rider. It changes no remaining movement allowance and grants no invented crushing damage. It does not permit a voluntary form change to bypass its preflight.

Track actual height and terrain. Losing flight while unsupported starts ordinary falling from the current location; reversion never moves the creature directly to the ground. Ending a burrowing form underground does not move the creature to the surface. Master of Vermin's permission to pass through Tiny gaps changes clearance, not its printed size.

Use the actual space of the expressed anatomy:

| Size | Space | On a grid of 2.5-foot subcells |
|---|---|---|
| Tiny | 2.5 by 2.5 feet | 1 subcell |
| Small | 5 by 5 feet | 2 by 2 subcells |
| Medium | 5 by 5 feet | 2 by 2 subcells |
| Large | 10 by 10 feet | 4 by 4 subcells |

V6 explicitly supplies Tiny and Medium space. Small and Large complete this bounded table provisionally; the supplied V6 passage does not separately list them. Size category still matters even when two sizes occupy the same space. Squeezing changes clearance and its penalties; it does not change size, carrying capacity or weight. Exact Tiny occupancy requires subcells or equivalent measurement, not treating Tiny as Medium.

## Carrying and Load

Use pounds for actual weight and Load for inventory burden. Extraction Class describes cargo danger and attention. A casualty's Load describes the difficulty of transporting a body; it is not the body's weight. These quantities answer different questions and never convert automatically into each other.

The following is a **new provisional reconciliation** of V6 physical handling with the staged Gameplay Loop inventory rules. It does not promote the historical Gameplay Loop file into the approved books. V6's optional encumbrance variant remains preserved as an alternative; do not add its penalties to this Load procedure.

| Carrier size | Physical carry limit in pounds | Push, drag or lift limit in pounds | Inventory capacity in Load | Casualty Load for a body of this size |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tiny | Strength score × 7.5 | Strength score × 15 | Strength score ÷ 2 | 1.5 |
| Small | Strength score × 15 | Strength score × 30 | Maximum of 0 and Strength score − 2 | 3 |
| Medium | Strength score × 15 | Strength score × 30 | Strength score | 6 |
| Large | Strength score × 30 | Strength score × 60 | Strength score × 2 | 12 |

Use the character's current Strength score, not the modifier or an imported monster score. Tiny's Inventory capacity and casualty Load are new provisional additions. The pound limits come from V6; Small, Medium and Large Load values come from the Gameplay Loop. Larger unsupported transport sizes require their own completed rule before this table can handle them.

Keep fractional Loads without rounding. An item with a printed Load uses that value. If it has only a known weight, its **provisional Load is pounds divided by ten**. A Load-only item may use ten pounds per Load as a clearly labeled estimate for ordinary hauling; this is insufficient for effects requiring documented physical mass.

Count a container's own empty Load plus the contents' Loads, unless an explicitly inclusive Load already covers those exact contents. Handle pounds separately: sum the empty container weight and contents' weights, or use an explicitly inclusive gross weight for the contents it covers. An inclusive Load does not make a printed weight inclusive, or vice versa. Apply this rule through nested containers and meld budgets so every item counts exactly once in each quantity.

With positive carried Load at or above half capacity and no greater than capacity, you are **Burdened**: reduce Speed by 10 feet and apply disadvantage to checks to climb, swim or move silently. An empty inventory is not Burdened, including at zero capacity. Above capacity, that inventory cannot be carried routinely; drop or transfer something, or use a legal alternative such as dragging or a vehicle. These threshold and zero-Load details are provisional clarifications.

Apply actual physical limits when handling a known weight. Between physical carry capacity and twice that capacity, pushing or dragging uses the lower of otherwise-current Speed and 5 feet. A Speed of 0 stays 0; a Speed of 3 stays 3. Lifting does not independently permit movement: moving while supporting a weight must satisfy carrying, pushing, dragging or another exact rule. An anatomy restriction, such as Hawk's prohibition on carrying a Medium ally, still applies even if numbers would fit. Burden penalties do not create hands, harnesses, lift or access to melded gear.

Transporting a creature must pass both checks: the carrier can physically handle the body's effective weight and associated equipment, and can accommodate the casualty Load plus the equipment's Load. Petrified multiplies the body weight by ten, not its casualty Load. Removing gear can reduce equipment weight and Load; it cannot reduce the body's weight or erase its condition.

exactAuthority.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only Antimagic Field (Lesser)
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
Action; range 10 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP. Preserve the source's 10-foot sphere and suppression promise. NEW: choose one perceived fixed point within 10 feet and line of effect; create a fixed 10-foot-radius sphere with concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, explicitly replacing the source's insufficient Instantaneous field duration for this authored procedure. The volume is clipped by actual solid total-cover barriers from the center and never follows a creature.

The field suppresses the local expression of actual ongoing spells and explicitly magical nonspell technique expressions only where their real body/effect/anchor intersects the operative volume. It supplies no rank ceiling. It does not retroactively undo completed damage, healing, movement, transmutation, consumed items, permanent ordinary matter, HP loss or source history. It does not erase class engines, learned facts, RP pools, injuries or intrinsic nonmagical traits. A magic item keeps its mundane body/ownership/contents while its magical enhancements/actions are unavailable. A creature-attached spell buff is wholly unavailable while the creature intersects; a large wall/field loses only its intersecting portion unless its own indivisible source says otherwise.

An otherwise legal spell cast may still be committed inside: pay its real final price, Action/components/cadence and concentration transition. If the spell's relevant manifestation originates inside the field, suppress that payload at resolution; there is no queued later release and no refund. Do not invent an imaginary straight-line beam/path for teleportation or nonprojectile magic. For current Dimensional Door, an origin and endpoint both outside the field are unaffected even if a drawn line crosses it; an origin actually inside the field has its spell payload suppressed after legal commitment. A remote ongoing effect outside is not canceled merely because its concentrating caster enters the field.

Ranger Nature's Whisper is an explicitly magical NONSPELL technique. Inside the field its Action+1 RP+Recharge 3 commitment remains a nonspell event; the magical payload/rider is unavailable with no rank, Counterspell window or Nexus/Dampening price. A still-live Nature's Whisper rider on an actor inside the field is unusable while suppressed but its clock continues.

Oracle's Burden prevents generic remove/suspend of the intrinsic Oracle Curse, so this field does not erase or suspend the Curse engine. Curse Manifestation, Tongues and Consumed retain only their own exact suppression/appearance permissions and timers.

Instances of Lesser Antimagic do not suppress one another; overlapping instances form the union of active volumes. This same-family exception only prevents oscillation and grants no ability to cast a new field from inside another without paying/satisfying the new cast, whose payload is itself exempt only because it is this family.

For Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01. For accepted ordinary Banishment, only actual suppression of the application itself invokes its own accepted closure/end rule; merely suppressing its distant caster does not reach the generated cell/application. For Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment, AC5-BANISH-EXT-01 expressly gives the same close-on-actual-suppression behavior.

Suppression never pauses absolute/source clocks and does not bank missed attacks, aura starts, periodic damage, saves or commands. On exit/end, only still-live source expressions resume with the same remaining HP/pools/deadlines. Wall of Force uses its own safe segment-resumption rule.

Repair04 incoming/output completion: use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04. An instantaneous effect cast outside is not immune merely because its source is outside: inspect the actual recipient/area/destination manifestation. Local damage/healing inside is suppressed with no packet/root; an outside-origin Dimensional Door whose destination footprint is inside fails atomically after cost, while outside→outside remains unaffected regardless of an imaginary line. A legal Greater Dispel or exact class Dispel resolves captured termination operations under AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04; the target Antimagic application ignores only its own suppression, while a different Antimagic field can still suppress that termination operation; ordinary Counterspell remains only a cast-time response before the field exists. Spell Preservation’s primary-book anti-destruction remains source-intrinsic even while magical book usability is suppressed.

It does not disclose hidden creatures, secret events, source/rank/DC/AC information, hidden modifier reasons, RNG seeds or future draws. An explicit source prohibition on disclosure takes precedence. Unlisted or unclassified events remain unavailable to these three Fate permissions until separately authored; absence of a secrecy tag is not a grant.

1. OVERT-ATTACK: for an actual ordinary Core attack whose generating creature, declared attack and target are already perceived/identified by the reacting creature through its real senses, give that creature's authorized controller the complete resolved original attack d20 set before hit/miss consequences. This is an explicit new result-presentation decision, not a new sensing ability. Display the faces and which original selection rule is being applied, not the hidden causes of advantage, the target's AC or hidden modifiers. A hidden attacker or an unperceived/unknown target does not qualify under this entry. An extra camera, spectator role, battle log or engine access is not perception. An AI controller receives only the corresponding authorized view, not the entire engine state.

2. OWN-REQUESTED-CHECK: an actually requested, nonsecret ordinary ability/skill/tool check presents its complete original d20 set privately to that actor's authorized controller. Automatic/secret sensing checks, protected inquiries and hidden contests are excluded. Another reacting character can use that player's legitimate display only when that reacting character independently satisfies its own actual source perception/range/LoE and resource predicates; this rule grants no character-to-character telepathy. In a multi-character player party, the player may control both actors; a multiplayer peer does not inherit another player's private grant.

3. BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE: once an actual reviewed Burning Hands cone is manifested and the shared 3d6 operation is generated, present the complete shared faces before damage consequences to the caster's controller and to controllers of reacting characters who actually perceive the caster and the manifested cone. This whitelist entry is specifically for the reviewed Burning Hands damage operation, not every damage pool. It reveals no target list, save result, resistance or hidden recipient. Per-recipient damage is still computed once from the one final shared total. A reaction holder must additionally pass its own actual Coin range/LoE/hand/custody predicates. A source-suppressed operation that creates no actual damage draw gives nothing to reroll.

4. CONFUSION-BEHAVIOR: for this pending Confusion procedure, show the actual finite d4 behavior, any genuinely generated d8 direction, and any genuinely generated uniform 1dN perceived-target selection privately to the affected body's authorized controller before that behavior executes. Do not expose candidates that this body cannot actually perceive. Other controllers receive no raw selection results under this entry. A player who also controls a reacting holder can use that legitimate result view only if the reacting holder independently perceives the true roll-generating body and passes Coin's other source requirements. The snapshotted set and candidate order are immutable; an empty set makes no draw. A private NPC-controller view is not disclosed to human players.

5. RESONANCE-WELL-RESERVE: show the actual initial 1d4 reserve-creation draw privately to the Well creator's authorized controller before the reserve is established. This preserves the existing timing boundary but authors its digital display; it does not expose any already-established or hidden reserve and does not permit a later reroll/refill. The reacting holder still needs Coin's real event perception/range/LoE/custody/Reaction.

For these entries only, record policyId, entryId, original event ID, the authorized controller set and the actual perception evidence at generation. Recheck the reacting source's own spatial/resource predicates at commitment. Already lawfully learned original faces are not erased by a later effect, but event knowledge alone never satisfies a currently missing character predicate. Present only information this whitelist actually grants, whether or not any observer possesses a Fate source; resource possession cannot become a detector. Total-only or hidden-result policies remain insufficient. Preserve the original RNG component IDs and reduction rule through replacement. No rejected declaration or paid-but-blocked alteration generates a replacement draw.

This is a minimum concrete policy, not a universal dice-visibility policy. In particular, unlisted enemy saving throws, trauma, secret checks, loot/world generation and private source operations remain unavailable. Future presentation entries require explicit source-specific authorship and separate review. Thus the presence, number, values, availability and timing of the published pool do not encode whether hidden recipients exist. No target list, saves, defenses or damage outcome is added to this presentation. A paid Coin may alter that original empty-cone pool only through its ordinary actual predicates, with its normal consumed item/Reaction/guard and no refunded cost; it creates no recipient or successful damage event. This is explicit NEW per-source RNG-generation authorship, not a rule for other empty areas or unlisted spells.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. One perceived creature with line of effect makes WIS. Success does nothing. At that START after normal processing and before voluntary movement, spend up to 30 feet of the target’s actual remaining ordinary movement moving as far as reasonably possible in that direction along a legal known route. The target/controller selects the safest legal route; use only its actual available movement modes, support and distances. No knowingly self-destructive route, unsupported step, prohibited transport or optional resource expenditure is compelled. Ordinary opportunity attacks remain possible; this is compelled use of movement, not push/pull displacement. No Dash, Action loss, extra movement, teleport permission or new speed is supplied. A blocked route or Speed 0 permits only the actual safe meaningful movement available, possibly none; no alternative direction or banked retry follows. The instruction competes through existing compelled-budget arbitration with priority at establishment. It has exactly one finite opportunity and expiry under DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03 below. A companion uses only movement in the real attached phase after the next original-owner regular turn that has not begun, bounded by the preserved original marker or six-second no-schedule fallback; it receives no extra phase, Action, offensive allowance or owner resource charge. NEW: one pending application per caster/target; a later actually established application replaces that caster’s prior one. Other casters’ instructions retain distinct histories but cannot reset the same movement budget. Suppression at the execution opportunity prevents execution without deferring it.

NEW PLANE AND MOVEMENT COMPLETION: Apply only the Compulsion clause of DE4-ORDER-DELIVERY-02. Its one fixed direction is recorded on the actual application plane. At the one future opportunity, cap the spendable ordinary movement budget at30feet and at the actual remaining allowed budget. Use real terrain/crawl/squeeze cost per foot; this does not promise30feet of path through arbitrary difficult geometry. No paid Dash, teleport, owner BA, unsupported step or fresh action is supplied. If the actual source plane, legal route, support or available movement is missing, perform only a lawful possible portion and consume the sole opportunity. No crossing to another plane creates a new compass system or postpones execution until return.

NEW DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03, scoped only to Compulsion: at successful failed-save establishment record one pending instruction, its application order, original timing basis and one finite latest opportunity marker. For a creature with a regular turn schedule, use its next future regular START, excluding a turn already underway. For an owner-attached chassis, use the attached-phase boundary after the next original-owner regular turn that has not begun; record the original regular owner END/attached-phase marker even if an actual phase may be unavailable then. If no such original schedule/marker exists, use application+6 elapsed seconds. These are spell-only timing records, not new creature turns. Preserve the original marker and its virtual elapsed-time mapping through initiative changes, absence, extra turns and relocation. Use at most one qualifying future actual movement opportunity within that window; an attached target can execute only in its real source-authorized original-owner regular attached phase. An already-underway owner turn supplies no newly compelled phase. A genuinely earlier qualifying opportunity after a schedule change can consume the instruction once, with only its actual remaining budget. A later rescheduling cannot carry the instruction past its original finite marker. At the recorded boundary, finish ordinary required START/phase processing before this instruction's sole eligibility/movement check; immediately after that check expire it whether movement was possible, blocked, suppressed or zero. This specifically typed expiry-after-opportunity ordering avoids expiring the instruction before its own simultaneous check; it is not a change to global phase0 duration expiry. When the actual lifecycle supplies no qualifying phase at the recorded boundary, perform an expiry-only bookkeeping check at that original marker and remove the instruction. This check grants no movement, Action, Reaction, recharge, control START, command or owner resource expenditure. An owner-attached target with no original schedule therefore expires at application+6 if no independently supplied lawful phase occurs first. A normal independent creature outside initiative can have the one expressly proposed ordinary movement opportunity by application+6 under the real shared behavior budget; establish initiative before hostile behavior. No phase, target physiology, missing movement mode or new budget is inferred from that fallback. A later repair, owner return, phase creation or suppression ending never replays an expired instruction. This is explicit NEW joint-review authorship, not an already accepted general timing rule.

completeSharedRules.title: Authority, access and cost
completeSharedRules.wording: The selected ordinary identity and its actual classAccess row control school, rank, minimum class level and base RP. Preserve the entire classAccess object, every catalog/Core original, book binding, placeholder, absent/null distinction and additionalRpCost. Enough RP does not grant access or repertoire. An already completed explicit ordinary-spell access exception, such as the actual Druid Circle always-prepared table, retains its real acquisition/rank/preparation gates once its matching payload passes exact review. Record that particular grant and use its actual class progression/cost; do not rewrite ordinary classAccess, infer a new variant from a same-named class power, or approve a pending class feature here. Rank costs remain 0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26 for ranks 0–9, with the actual class engine, discounts, Dissonance surcharge and additional/maintenance costs separately applied. Oracle Revelations remain RC techniques; a same-named class, ancestry or recipe permission is not this ordinary spell. No default upcast or cantrip level scaling is added. Every direction below is authoring authority only; every existing source operational:null and pending status remains untouched until separate exact review.

completeSharedRules.title: Actual casting transaction
completeSharedRules.wording: Use the selected source Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or longer casting time and actual V/S/F or M/F requirements. V requires the caster's own presently usable voice; recordings are not V. S and a real permitted focus obey the existing hand/access rules. Unpriced M/F permits the actual focus alternative and creates no invented costly/consumed material fee. Explicit physical substrates below are real target/work prerequisites, not inferred M costs. Observable legality is checked before commitment; hidden immunity/type/meaning does not become free diagnosis. At commitment spend the actual action/resources and update actual cast/cadence history before the existing counterspell chain; a countered, missed or resisted committed cast refunds nothing. Concentration begins under the existing rule and can end the old concentration even when the new cast is countered. Long casting uses actual uninterrupted work and governing interruption/Ready rules. No successful spell roll authenticates an asserted object, voice, teacher, corpse or world permission.

completeSharedRules.title: Native rolls and damage
completeSharedRules.wording: Spell attacks use the actual owner's spell attack modifier versus AC: natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles damage dice of that attack, not flat modifiers or later ticks. Saves are binary total-versus-spell-DC, with no natural-die degree shift. A specified examination is an INT (Investigation) task against the creating caster's snapshotted spell DC: use Core degrees/natural shifts, then collapse Success/Critical Success versus Failure/Critical Failure unless an entry supplies distinct outcomes. For one simultaneous area effect, snapshot geometry and eligible targets before damage, roll each stated shared damage expression once, then apply each recipient's save and actual type defenses independently. Half damage floors each typed component once at the stated save stage. Follow the existing reduction, immunity/resistance/vulnerability, temporary/form buffer, actual HP loss, Wound, death and concentration pipeline. No descriptive Damage/Healing/Control tag supplies an additional attack, damage, healing or condition.

completeSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW explicit use where source timing is absent
completeSharedRules.title: Clocks
completeSharedRules.wording: A bare hostile one-round rider ends at the end of the target's next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn at application; a bare self/ally one-round benefit ends at the start of the caster's next future regular turn. N hostile rounds use the Nth such target end; N buff rounds use the Nth caster start. Outside initiative, those are 6N elapsed seconds. Keep the registered clock through initiative changes using the existing virtual-clock adapter; extra turns do not create expiry/tick opportunities. A NEW duration expressed in minutes/hours below uses an absolute elapsed deadline from completed resolution, including an absolute 60-second deadline for “1 minute”; the one-minute means neither an extra initial tick nor reset when initiative starts. Repeated round damage expressly uses future target regular-end checkpoints and its printed finite count, not one immediate tick plus that count. End-turn ticks/repeat saves precede their scheduled end-turn expiry; start expiry precedes voluntary actions. Suppression pauses eligibility/effect, not deadlines; scheduled suppressed ticks are spent, never queued. Entries that expressly use a named trigger instead of a generic clock keep that trigger.

completeSharedRules.title: Multiplicity, effect identity and present state
completeSharedRules.wording: Keep the existing strongest same-stat flat bonus, same-family cover arbitration, advantage/disadvantage cancellation and one eligible bonus-die spell per roll. Independent class exceptions retain their exact scopes; this is not a universal strongest-effect rule. NEW default for these previously uncompleted spells: one active instance per caster per ordinary spell ID, unless a row expressly permits more; a successfully resolved replacement ends that caster's prior instance, but an illegal/countered attempt does not replace a nonconcentration instance. Different casters retain separate source records, clocks and restrictions; identical numeric bonuses never add. A current complete record is required for every competing effect. Instantaneous completed consequences are not active-instance stock. An entry explicitly limiting waiting triggers counts only its stated waiting state; its spent playback phase never refills or occupies a waiting slot. Continual Flame explicitly permits separate paid anchors, with only its per-anchor limit; do not impose the default one-caster limit on it. Loss, repair, transfer, suppression or a new database ID cannot renew an already consumed mark, scheduled tick, trigger, command budget or source resource. Removal of one source does not erase another's independent condition. Any change in actual target/custody state is logged; it is not a new casting.

completeSharedRules.title: Attack/check marks
completeSharedRules.wording: A row expressly saying attack commitment reserves and spends its mark when the beneficiary commits a legal declared attack, before a roll; cancellation after that commitment and a miss do not refund it, while an illegal declaration that never commits does not spend it. Otherwise “next attack/check” marks spend on the next actual qualifying roll, including a miss/failure; unrelated rolls and passive procedures do not consume them. Mark recipients cannot choose to save a mark for a later preferred roll. A next-hit rider spends on the first qualifying hit, even if defenses reduce its damage to zero. Multiple competing next-roll marks eligible for the same event all spend, though only permitted strongest/advantage effects operate. Suppressed marks do not benefit or consume on an event while suppressed, but their deadline continues. Delivery attacks and later attacks consuming a delivered mark are different events.

completeSharedRules.title: Sight, illusions and meaning
completeSharedRules.wording: An image is not an opaque physical barrier, creature, material, light source, safe floor, sound receiver or extra targetable body unless its row expressly creates that thing. Ordinary hearing needs a real acoustic path; sight needs the relevant illumination, range and unobstructed view. Knowing an illusion does not grant sight through a real wall. For visual/audio deceptions below that permit examination, one Action using a currently accessible relevant sense can make the LR-G03 examination; success identifies that cast as illusory for that observer, while failure permits another examination only after genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive witnessed physical contradiction establishes the applicable false part without a roll. An ally's warning allows examination but does not globally switch every observer to knowing. These procedures do not compel belief, pursuit, an attack, trust or a sale. Current Invisible rules remain: invisibility is not automatic Hidden; observers who know location lose only the special invisibility-derived attack advantage/disadvantage, not unrelated concealment. Language samples reproduce what was heard, not meaning or credentials. Preserve LA's six-second aggregate voluntary-speech budget per numbered round and actual component/oath windows. Spell-created sounds are not the caster's later speech, but original recording speech and the caster's V are real speech.

completeSharedRules.title: Range, targets and geometry
completeSharedRules.wording: Unless a specific row explicitly uses detection without sight, select an actually perceived eligible target or point within the literal Core range and with the existing line of effect. A target can be self within a creature-target range unless the source/row restricts it. “Willing” means current actual consent; an unwilling holder prevents a willing-only object spell without supplying an opposed-roll workaround. Detecting some magic is not necessarily perceiving a creature for targeting it. One target means one physical identity, not every same-named database row. NEW missing cone width is its length at its far end; missing line cross-section is five feet wide and five feet high. All source radii remain radii, not distances added to cast range. Area membership/cover are evaluated from the actual origin at that event; walls are not retroactively removed for a second pass. “Enemies” uses the caster's declared ordinary opposition set, not a supernatural alignment/intent detector. Caster/allies are included in indiscriminate areas. No range is silently replaced by an outside game's value.

completeSharedRules.title: Conditions and hard-control guard
completeSharedRules.wording: Use actual Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, Prone, Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed and Stunned definitions without importing another game. Paralyzed/Incapacitated and other hard Action denial obey the current source-character/target/encounter allowance shared across that owner's effects; only successfully established hard control spends it, once for the effect's full allowed window. A blocked hard portion supplies no invented substitute penalty; independently printed damage, Prone or another separately allowed portion can remain. A spell's repeat save ends only the stated source. Ending laughter, restraint or paralysis does not automatically stand a Prone target. NEW “flee” directions below require actual safe available movement away at the next regular-turn movement opportunity, using existing Speed/cost and leaving Actions to the target; they do not force Dash, expend a Reaction or require deliberate self-harm. If no safe farther legal location exists, no movement is forced and no action is lost. Panicked is explicitly bound only in IL-23, not added as a global condition. Haste's voluntary ending cost is separately addressed in R3-12.

completeSharedRules.title: Movement, falls and body continuity
completeSharedRules.wording: Ordinary movement spends real movement cost and needs nonzero permitted Speed, legal support, actual space and the appropriate locomotion mode; changing a speed or mode does not reset spent cost. A spell-directed extra movement allowance expressly stated below supplies only that finite allowance. Teleportation relocates rather than traverses, does not itself provoke opportunity attacks and does not generically defeat a source that blocks relocation; no route is inferred through planes. Check destination occupancy, whole body/gear geometry and lawful carry/load. Supplying a point is not permission to materialize inside another body. Unsupported endings, launches and lost flight use the existing FallMarker and finite falling resolution, not a new immediate damage tick. Actual transformations retain original identity, own HP/resources, spent state, origin restrictions and body/equipment priority; no new monster sheet, harvest pool, HP refill, gear duplication or size-based ability increase. Actual equipment can be melded only by the stated form procedure, stays real weight/history and is unavailable while melded.

completeSharedRules.title: Summons, corpse assets and commands
completeSharedRules.wording: Each row supplies its actual finite body, attack and lifetime rather than importing a monster. Use printed HP/AC before any new fallback. For the NEW profiles below, creating caster's class level/PB/ability at creation fixes any printed-derived maximum; attacks and saves use that same source owner's currently lawful spell attack/PB, not a transferee's or a monster's sheet. Unless stated, saves add owner's PB, ordinary ability/skill checks add 0, normal vision only, no special damage or condition immunity, no independent equipment proficiency or spellcasting. One such spell-created asset per caster per spell ID; the existing total companion/control budget still binds. Creation grants no free attack or movement. A command uses one Bonus Action on the owner's regular turn through actual visible/audible communication within 60 ft; no telepathy is invented. It acts in the attached phase after that whole turn, shares the owner's one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round, and has no independent refresh on extra turns. Uncommanded it can only ordinary Dodge and make defensive movement within speed; no automatic pursuit, work or offense. Loss of the channel means no new command, not free autonomy. A complete task needs its real appendages, capacity, instructions and paid time. At 0 HP, expiry, source dismissal (Action) or concentration end where required, the asset ends; summoned apparatus disappears without loot, corpses, ammunition, harvest or salvage. An actual corpse used as fuel retains its original finite matter/history and the stated terminal consumption; no source can reclassify it as newly obtained material. Keep Ranger's genuinely ordinary animal remains distinct from no-resource summons.

completeSharedRules.title: Suppression and trigger ordering
completeSharedRules.wording: An ongoing magical object's target stays the same physical anchor; transfer or repair cannot duplicate/rearm it. Full magical suppression prevents sensing/operation while it lasts and does not queue missed triggers; duration continues. An acoustic silence can block only sound independently of a physically detected trigger. Resolve simultaneous eligible one-shot triggers in creation order then stable cast ID. Consume a triggered use before its payload, even when a later barrier, silence, immunity, cancellation or receiver state prevents useful output. A sound produced by another real spell can be a phonetic trigger if all actual constraints match, but each waiting trigger resolves at most once and cannot recreate itself or another charge. Source death/distance ends a nonconcentration effect only where the source/row says so; it does not refresh it. Suppression does not undo already completed mundane writing, moved matter, healing, damage or superficial preparation. An explicit persistent permanent spell remains a magical effect, not a manufactured item or free rechargeable device.

completeSharedRules.disposition: NEW spell-specific wrapper family; existing costs/cadence kept
completeSharedRules.title: Copying, acceleration, delay and proxies
completeSharedRules.wording: Cantrip Echo, Echo Cast, Quick Cast and Delay Spell are the only new wrapper identities authorized here. None may take itself or any of those four as payload, nor may an already echoed/released payload become a replay source. One payload may receive at most one of these temporal/replay modifications; they do not duplicate Ready or grant an additional Bonus Action, Reaction or full Action. Existing acquired class permissions remain their own exceptions, not automatically folded into this family. Select the actual original casting record, same ordinary source class and native legal access; only that spell's normal Action version with one finite resolution is eligible, excluding long casts, Reactions, Bonus Action spells and ongoing maintenance actions. Repeating a miss or resisted but fully resolved cast permits a fresh legal cast, not copying its damage result; a countered or aborted original is not a replay source. New targets/range/components and current costs/statistics must qualify at the new commitment. No active rider, successful roll, other caster's access, expended item charge or selected resource award is copied for free. Cantrip Echo's row defines one composite ordinary-cast transaction; Echo Cast/Quick Cast/Delay Spell instead have their separately paid arming transactions and later actual payload commitments. Record parent, wrapper, payload, cost, original owner and single-use consumption. No zero-base-cost replay recursively generates resource refunds or unearned casts. A legal fresh payload still resolves its own actual damage and expressly funded healing; this guard prevents copied old awards and recursive new-cast/refund grants, not the payload’s specified new outcome. Resonance Tether changes a legitimate delivery origin only, never the responsible caster or their RP/RC pool.

completeSharedRules.title: Reflection without a new cast
completeSharedRules.wording: Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror intercept only the first actually resolving ordinary spell effect that has exactly their warded creature as its sole direct creature recipient, beneficial or hostile. Area, multitarget, self-only, anchor/object, summoning, channel/ongoing tick and already redirected effects are ineligible. NEW interception/return distinction: a Touch-delivered, healing or willing-recipient spell is eligible for interception when it satisfies the foregoing sole-recipient and scope requirements. The original caster's eligibility to receive the return, including actual consent and creature-type requirements, is tested only after that eligible ward has been spent. An ineligible original caster therefore causes a spent, unsuccessful return and leaves the original recipient, exactly as below. A legal Touch return uses this explicit magical return, not a new physical touch or Action. No rank cap is added; actual protective exceptions can still forbid redirection. After counterspell resolution but before that spell's attack/save/effect, spend the ward once and substitute the original actual caster as recipient only when it is presently a legal recipient under the payload's own type/other eligibility. The original caster remains owner and supplies DC/attack roll and costs; this creates no new casting, resources or second packet. An ineligible original caster causes the spent redirection to fail and the original spell continues against its original warded target, not automatic cancellation. An eligible redirected attack can miss normally; spend is not refunded. The original targeting distance has already been established; the explicit return uses that same causal cast, with return line blocked by an actual barrier defeating the return path, not arbitrary remote range extension. A blocked return likewise leaves the original target. A causal root can be redirected at most once by these two spells; another mirror on the new target neither redirects it again nor consumes its ward. Duplicate wards on the original target arbitrate earliest creation then stable ID; only the selected ward spends. These are NEW finite interpretations of “first/single-target spell,” not permissions for Wizard/Oracle or other reflected-damage features to use this protocol.

completeSharedRules.title: Necrotic damage, healing, corpses and restrictions
completeSharedRules.wording: Actual damage and healing follow completed Core and feat procedures. No ordinary necrotic spell gains Bleeding, disease, Oracle Decay, a curse, corpse fuel, a soul resource or a healing prohibition by name/tag. A drain's specific permitted funding is stated in its row; an unfunded heal/RP transfer cannot be manufactured from overkill, a reflected packet, an already paid award, target transfer, current permission overriding no-resource origin, or a temporary body. Existing Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch, Lifeleech, Necrotic Affinity, Soul Cage feat and class drains keep their own nonidentical source predicates; the new drain restrictions are not retrospective amendments to them. Actual independently eligible acquired feats can respond once under their completed source rules, never a second time to the resulting heal/resource transfer. A corpse interface uses actual dead identity and retained memory; it does not establish an afterlife, soul custody, truth beyond memory or current thoughts. Preserve actual death/removal clocks, condition and no-resource restrictions through stabilization, question, animation and return. A later paid question cannot retrieve information the old remains never retained; fragments are one donor history, not separate minds.

completeSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW bounded physical work choices
completeSharedRules.title: Real matter, preparations and economy
completeSharedRules.wording: A spell moving or reshaping real matter retains the actual predecessor quantity, material, contents, owner, damage and consumed/harvest history. Count retained mass and disposed matter once. It does not change source tier, named ingredient eligibility, equipment grade, formula knowledge, rarity, assigned value, an old recovery claim or an apparatus's paid service/charges. Cosmetic temperature/color/shape does not sterilize food, undo spoilage, neutralize a poison or supply a professional crafting result. Explicit elementary structures allowed below still need real support and dimensions; no unknown material or hidden load-bearing property is authenticated by the spell. A genuine subsequently usable mundane item can enter only its actual existing rules and finite market; no automatic sale price, buyer, XP or crafting-output multiplication. Fulfilled 687/433 recipe and NWX/LA procedures remain controlling.

completeSharedRules.title: Concentration and early termination
completeSharedRules.wording: Where a row says concentration, it occupies the one actual concentration slot, ends under the completed damage-save/incapacitation rules and can be ended voluntarily under that rule; no new per-round maintenance RP is imposed. A source explicitly printing concentration keeps it even when an independent rider ends sooner. NEW voluntary early termination for a nonconcentration instance authored below requires the original caster's Action and actual perception of its anchor/recipient within that spell's original range; no remote recall or refund. Instant completed consequences cannot be voluntarily reversed. Named permanent Until Dispelled effects have no general voluntary end from this default; use their own source or actual dispel. Invalid physical continued operation removes only what can no longer function; full destruction of a required anchor ends its anchored instance. No repaired anchor is a new instance.

completeSharedRules.title: Aliases and unassigned variants
completeSharedRules.wording: Uncontrollable Laughter uses the matching historical Tasha's Hideous Laughter Core metadata only through the explicit IL-18 binding; Resonance Tether analogously uses Mana Tether through UN-13. Preserve both historical names, exact effects and alias records without adding separate ordinary identities. Prestidigitation's two actual school modes are independently specified in IL-06 and selected by the cast's actual access row. Phantasmal Force rank 3, Stone Shape rank 4 and Mislead rank 5 remain preserved unassigned alternative records: no current classAccess row acquires those higher-rank modes, no chooser can buy them by paying more RP, and no new question or ordinary promotion is invented for them. The assigned lower-rank modes receive complete directions. Echo Cast's Core “base RP” is the chosen operational reading of its catalog's broader shorthand. Soul Tap's catalog HP AND Resonance selects the joint operation explicitly. Unravel Spell's “Tier 4” means the generating ordinary spell's rank≤4, not material/equipment/creature tier. All differences stay beside unchanged competing source fields.

completeSharedRules.title: Audience and comparison records
completeSharedRules.wording: All 137 selected ordinary identities and 141 original book bindings remain preserved internally; public teaching uses only actual public fields and the resulting operational mode when later exactly reviewed. A source mention does not publish a private dossier, class membership, material source or hidden research metadata. The 54 full selected class comparisons and 114 distinct spell counterparts retain their actual IDs, resource engines, windows and statuses; matching names/words do not merge any of them. Pending feats and spell comparisons stay pending. The eight submitted proposals are separately disposed below as source directions, not adopted by their mere inclusion. No change to the fulfilled language, teaching or recipe authority is required by these ordinary directions.

completeSharedRules.title: Delivery and deferred receipts
completeSharedRules.wording: R3-04 Blink is receipt-only: retain its full original and question, current pending operational state and literal setting references; author no plane itinerary, probability, reappearance/body procedure or promotion. Other incidental literal names, including Silent Ones, Heartcell, Matrix, Voice and deep-language terms when present, remain source receipts without interpretation. Local portals/teleports below are explicitly local procedures, not a decision about cosmology. Source authority here does not certify gameplay runtime, human teaching/balance, bestiary/acquisition availability, DD01 or final systemic consistency. Owner's final whole-game flow precedes an authorized GitHub push; verified remote commit precedes careful cosmology review. No deletion/push is authorized.

completeCurrentCard.name: Slow

operational.targets: Actual Enchantment mode: choose up to six creatures you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect. Actual Transmutation mode: the triggering creature must be perceived within 60 feet and line of effect and must be selected; choose up to five additional such creatures. The actual casting class determines school/mode; paying the same rank-3/base-5-RP price never grants the other package.
operational.duration: Both modes: concentration, up to one minute. In initiative, the maximum ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. If begun outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; no timing-mode change resets it.
operational.resolution: Enchantment uses an Action and an independent Wisdom save per target. Transmutation uses a Reaction when a creature you perceive within 60 feet/line of effect begins a distinct voluntary movement segment or begins an Action on its own actual turn, after required declaration/commitment and before the segment’s first step or Action’s first main outcome. An extra turn can trigger; Bonus Actions and Reactions cannot. Transmutation gives each chosen target an independent Constitution save. Success: no new effect for that target. Failure: apply only that actual mode’s independently defended rider set. Each affected creature repeats that mode’s recorded WIS or CON save at every affected regular-turn END, including the current regular turn if applied during it; success ends that cast’s application on that creature. Extra turns grant no ending saves. Outside initiative an otherwise legally established ongoing effect uses the specifically bound six-second END-save cadence, never a new Reaction trigger.
operational.effect: Enchantment failure: half Speed under existing strongest-adverse-Speed arbitration; -2 AC; -2 Dexterity ability checks and Dexterity saving throws, expressly excluding initiative; and at most one full Action commitment per actual turn. It changes no DEX score/modifier, DEX attack/damage, spell DC or other unnamed derived statistic. AC has only its separate -2. Count an Action already committed before application toward the ceiling; an already-legally-committed second Action still finishes, but no further Action can be committed that turn. The ceiling applies independently on extra turns; it retains Bonus Actions, Reactions and inherent attacks in a legal Attack Action. Transmutation failure: half Speed, -2 AC and no future Reaction commitments. It imposes no DEX penalty or Action ceiling. Already-committed unresolved Reactions remain on the LIFO stack. Neither mode grants unprinted spell delay, attack-count restriction, Action/Bonus-Action interchange, cancellation or teleport restriction.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: Transmutation’s movement trigger is one distinct segment, such as moving, performing an Action, then resuming movement; choosing another square during continuous movement is not a new segment, and individual feet/tiles are never new triggers. A paid Slow remains independent if a legal nested interruption removes the original parent Action: resolve it against still-legal selected targets, without refund, revival or parent cancellation. A surviving parent Action continues after the interrupt stack; movement recalculates remaining legal allowance before the next expenditure, keeping all movement already spent. The one-Action ceiling, Reaction denial and other soft riders do not claim whole-Action hard-control allowance. Actual narrowly scoped defenses can suppress individual components. Each cast/mode retains separate caster, concentration, saves and deadline. Half-Speed records compete against the same pre-control Speed, then existing later systemic multipliers apply. Identical Slow -2 AC and DEX penalties do not add; independent Enchantment and Transmutation casts may supply their distinct surviving riders together. Enchantment access: Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard, Paladin. Transmutation access: Dragoon, Druid, Mage, Monk, Ranger, Shaman, Tinker. Preserve each exact minimum class level. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both school/rank-3 modes, 60 feet, V/S/F, up to six targets; Enchantment Action/half Speed/-2 AC/-2 DEX/one action, and Transmutation Reaction/half Speed/-2 AC/no Reactions. NEW: WIS versus CON, concentration minute/repeat END saves, explicit distinct-segment/Action Reaction window with mandatory triggering target, scoped DEX exception and full-Action ceiling. No mode union from a single cast; independent overlaps keep provenance.

procedure.completeText:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, instantaneous 10d8 lightning to one primary and arcs to three secondary targets. NEW choose one primary perceived creature or independently legal exposed object within 60 feet and caster line of effect, then up to three distinct secondary eligible creatures/objects that the caster actually perceives. Each secondary must satisfy the explicit same-point-pair primary-volume30-foot range and line-of-effect test below at the original pre-damage snapshot. A secondary need not be within 60 feet of the caster, but perception must be genuine at its actual distance. No one identity can occupy two selections, including a large body's overlapping spaces; the primary cannot receive a returning arc. Exclude hostile worn/carried gear unless an actual separate source permits targeting it. Independently targetable objects need real durability/material defenses; the spell does not invent a vulnerable HP track for a wall of force, artifact or undefined world feature.

For a direct cast declare all selected identities before commitment. For a legally readied casting, select and recheck those identities at release under the accepted Ready rule; spell/mode and all preparation costs were already committed. After the interrupt window, recheck the primary and all selected secondary predicates using the then-current positions and fix that one pre-damage snapshot. If the primary has become illegal, the spell has no anchor and gives no damage or arcs; costs remain spent. An unavailable secondary is simply omitted, with no replacement after outcomes. NEW every included creature makes an independent DEX save for full 10d8 on failure or half on success. The missing secondary quantity is expressly completed as the same full 10d8 lightning as the primary, not assumed from an external ruleset. Roll the raw 10d8 once for the whole cast; ordinary target defenses and separate recipient packets apply. Legal objects take that amount without a creature save unless their actual object profile supplies one.

The arcs are established from the legal primary whose actual primary application is permitted at the snapshot, not purchased by damaging it. A successful primary save, lightning immunity, full prevention of HP damage or death from its own packet does not cancel already established arcs. There is no attack roll or miss result in this save-based proposal. Each secondary's save, immunity or death likewise has no effect on another. Total effect-blocking cover on one arc removes only that arc at the snapshot; destroying that cover later in the event cannot restore or add it. All four identities share the one cast and raw-roll identity but keep separate damage roots and actual source-trigger scope. No recursive secondary arcs, rebound hits, new targets in conductive water, blindness, stun, ignition or ongoing electrical field are added. Up to three means a legal cast can have zero, one, two or three available secondaries without manufacturing targets or forcing harm to an unchosen ally.

NEW AC6 CURRENT INTERFACE COMPLETION FOR CONFERENCE: At the successful post-interrupt snapshot the primary must be a legal target and an operative primary application must be permitted, before it can supply this spell's secondary emissions. An actual field preventing that primary application prevents the dependent arcs; mere damage immunity/defense/prevention, save outcome or subsequent primary death does not. The real primary body at the pre-damage snapshot is the expressly authorized origin for each secondary arc for geometric/Globe predicates. This changes no dealer: the original caster remains each recipient root's dealer under Null. Recheck each secondary's actual payload defenses independently without retargeting, recursive arcs or a second target scan. This local origin/primary-application distinction is NEW and requires review against the accepted ward interfaces; it is not already granted by random Chain Arc.

NEW DC25-CHAIN-LOCUS-01, CHAIN LIGHTNING ONLY. Use the primary's exact actual occupied body or eligible object's collision volume snapshotted after real cast interruptions. A secondary qualifies only if there exists one same pair of actual primary/secondary points joined by an unobstructed segment of at most30 Euclidean feet. The distance witness cannot come from a blocked near face while line of effect comes from a different out-of-range far face. The caster must still actually perceive every selected secondary; this test grants no remote perception from the primary. This is an explicit new extension for this spell, not inheritance of random Chain Arc's target selection, range metric, public dice, owner or recursion. The original primary volume is the authorized physical arc-source locus; it never becomes a new caster/dealer. Snapshot it before damage. Primary immunity, prevention of HP loss, or its later damage-caused death is not absence of the original operative application and does not move this locus. Conversely, if that primary application is itself prevented at the established permission checkpoint, there are no dependent arcs. Determine each secondary's own actual prevention/cover at its original selected endpoint; a shared RNG value gives neither a shared recipient root nor a new application through a blocker.

Origin-sensitive accepted fields use that expressly authorized real primary arc locus for dependent arcs and the actual generating rank of this spell. Ordinary rank6 Chain Lightning is ABOVE the accepted Globe0–5 ceiling; do not claim that its normal arc is blocked by Globe, or reduce its rank merely because an RP discount/waiver applied. No origin is invented at a desired secondary point, through a wall, or at the caster's display cursor. The chosen selected identities and snapshot are not rescanned after damage.

completeSharedRules.digitalGeometry: NEW scoped geometry for these25 cards: use actual world-space 3D occupied body volumes and Euclidean feet, not display sprites or the historical grid diagonal metric. Single-target range is the nearest actual caster-to-target body distance. A chosen area center must be a perceived point within the stated range from the actual caster body, with originating line of effect. A creature qualifies only if at least one actual body point intersects the closed specified volume and has line of effect from the relevant area origin/center. Tangency counts as intersection. Total cover prevents that application. Fix the whole recipient set and geometry after cast interruptions and before damage; destroying cover gives no second scan. Friendly targets and the caster are included whenever an ALL-creature shape actually includes them; ENEMIES means creatures the caster already ordinarily identifies as enemies at this snapshot, with no hidden-hostility or faction scan. No spell title creates an object-targeting permission. A card's own explicit origin exclusion, object mode, prism/cone shape or actual typed predicate takes precedence.
completeSharedRules.lineAndCone:

Cone of Cold retains60ft axial length with full diameter d at axial distance d, so radius=d/2 and far diameter60. Use exact continuous Euclidean body intersection, not a tabletop raster convention. NEW DC25-SHAPE-POSE-01, limited to these proposed cards: store the actual shape origin/center and its complete orientation at the legal geometry-selection checkpoint (normal commitment, or target selection at a legal Ready release). For Meteor Spear record a unit forward axis and two mutually perpendicular unit cross-section axes forming an orthonormal frame; points are origin+s*forward+u*right+v*up, 0<=s<=60 and |u|,|v|<=2.5. This removes undefined roll about a vertical/oblique spear axis. For Horrid Wilting record three orthonormal cube axes; each signed coordinate relative to the perceived chosen center lies in[-15,15]. No rounding of a sphere or cone to occupied grid tiles is permitted. Cylinders and the circular cone are rotationally symmetric about their stored axes; do not add an arbitrary prism height to them. Closed-body tangency counts except the card's explicit origin-only caster contact exclusion. Range/line-of-effect/field-origin predicates continue to use their actual source, not a rendering transform. Geometry choices are declared before results and never selected to fit a later save, hidden-defense result or damage outcome. This does not change another accepted spell or the global movement geometry.
completeSharedRules.saveAndDamage: A specified save uses8+PB+the real casting modifier under the actual placement/class and actual modifiers. Save outcomes are binary, not degrees; save damage never criticals. For each card use exactly its success branch, not a universal half-damage default. Unless a card expressly says per-target, use one shared raw pool for its area/chain and separate recipient damage packets, roots and actual defenses. Elemental Devastation explicitly rolls separately per enemy. Mixed typed parts of one actual hit stay one damage event for Wound/zero/lifecycle consequences; Meteor Spear alone uses its explicitly NEW DC25-MIXED-DEFENSE-02 apportionment at the one actually authorized source stage; this is not a general mixed-damage engine. completeSharedRules.rootsAndSuppression: At the actual permitted damage application create each recipient root under the accepted creation-time dealer/Null rules, even when the RNG pool is shared. Caster is the dealer for these direct spells; an arc origin is not a new dealer. Separate recipients and genuinely separate casts keep distinct roots. Apply current Lesser Antimagic, Globe and genuine defenses to actual payload locus/origin/rank. Globe blocks only its covered incoming rank0–5 application; rank6+ is outside that ceiling. An initially prevented rider does not establish or wait for later suppression ending. Established condition records retain identity, clocks and spent history through suppression; expired/ended records never replay. Completed instantaneous damage is not dispellable after the fact. No attack, roll, concentration, resource or root is manufactured by presentation or reentry.

Establishment spends the hard guard once; no later recast, source rename, suppression or expiration refunds it. completeSharedRules.recordsAndCleanup: Record exact generating spell ID, school/rank, class/source owner, cast/event order, target, components, saved outcome, source DC, initial/root IDs, actual absolute or typed deadline, concentration link, spent guard and suppression state. For each successor, form the finite candidate set of unvisited actual creatures meeting AC6-CHAIN-GEOMETRY-05 against the immediately previous selected creature's snapshotted occupied body volume. Include allies and the caster when eligible; no selective exclusion after results. NEW successors need not be perceived by the caster or within the caster's original60foot range, because this spell's actual random arc selects from its local geometry. This is a source-specific targeting extension, not a general permission for hidden-target spells. Director-held hidden identities can be candidates without revealing a roster or new diagnostic to the caster. Order the candidate set by stable preexisting encounter/body identity, assign indices1..N, and draw one uniform integer from1..N using a declared fair1dN/digital die. Select that one index once. This is a finite draw, not repeated d20 rejection until a favorable or legal result appears. A known empty set ends the chain immediately; do not invent targets or revisit an earlier identity to reach six.

Build the entire chain in that snapshot before any damage. Remove each selected identity from later candidate sets, even if its body occupies multiple squares. The recorded random selections and order cannot be changed after observing saves, HP loss or immunity. Each selected creature then independently makes DEX for a shared rolled3d8 lightning, full on failure or half rounded down on success before defenses. A selected creature's successful save, lightning immunity, zero damage or death from its packet does not sever already-established later arcs. No attack roll, critical damage, extra damage from metal, conductive-water expansion, stun, blindness or recursive fork is added. A creature actually removed before its own already-selected packet by an independent legal immediate response follows that response's real effect; no replacement or fresh random draw is supplied, and the other pre-established selections remain.

The draw method is transparent, but a public list of hidden candidates, their number, exact positions, alignment or defenses is not a spell benefit. Ordinary visible lightning/harm remains observable, and the spell does not promise that an affected hidden creature leaves no evidence. With fewer available targets the cast simply affects fewer than six. Each successive targeting gap is at most30feet under AC6-CHAIN-GEOMETRY-05. Body extent prevents treating initial60plus five30foot gaps as a universal center-to-center endpoint limit. No arbitrary farthest endpoint is targeted directly. A genuine subsequent cast pays again and forms a new chain; copies/echoes obey their actual event/source permissions rather than reusing a random choice as an extra hit. After all legal selections and their roll replacements are final, create the instantaneous cast's recipient damage roots together before the first recipient damage packet: each has the caster as dealer, that caster's actual Veil state at this common checkpoint, its own recipient identity and the same cast lineage. Subsequent pure transfers retain those flags. Independent events later removing a selected recipient can prevent its pending packet but cannot redraw or erase the other already-established roots/arcs. No actualDamageDealt, Wound, death or resource trigger occurs merely because an identity was selected or a root allocated.

CURRENT FAIR-DRAW COMPLETION: apply AC6-CHAIN-RANDOM-01. Stable candidate arrays are fixed before each physical/random draw; allies and unseen locally eligible creatures remain in the array. Fate Coin can reroll a public physical selection die only when its actual reaction/guard predicates are met. No retry-until-valid and no post-damage redraw.

Order the candidate set by stable preexisting encounter/body identity, assign indices1..N, and draw one uniform integer from1..N using a declared fair1dN/digital die. Select that one index once. This is a finite draw, not repeated d20 rejection until a favorable or legal result appears. A known empty set ends the chain immediately; do not invent targets or revisit an earlier identity to reach six.

Build the entire chain in that snapshot before any damage. Remove each selected identity from later candidate sets, even if its body occupies multiple squares. The recorded random selections and order cannot be changed after observing saves, HP loss or immunity. Each selected creature then independently makes DEX for a shared rolled3d8 lightning, full on failure or half rounded down on success before defenses. A selected creature's successful save, lightning immunity, zero damage or death from its packet does not sever already-established later arcs. No attack roll, critical damage, extra damage from metal, conductive-water expansion, stun, blindness or recursive fork is added. A creature actually removed before its own already-selected packet by an independent legal immediate response follows that response's real effect; no replacement or fresh random draw is supplied, and the other pre-established selections remain.

The draw method is transparent, but a public list of hidden candidates, their number, exact positions, alignment or defenses is not a spell benefit. Ordinary visible lightning/harm remains observable, and the spell does not promise that an affected hidden creature leaves no evidence. With fewer available targets the cast simply affects fewer than six. Its longest theoretical six-body straight sequence is initial60plus five30foot jumps, but every actual hop still needs the snapshotted geometry; no arbitrary farthest endpoint is targeted directly. A genuine subsequent cast pays again and forms a new chain; copies/echoes obey their actual event/source permissions rather than reusing a random choice as an extra hit. After instantaneous resolution there is no continuing chain, charge, creature, storm or lingering field to dispel. This spell remains distinct from the proposed freely selected four-target10d8 Chain Lightning; neither damage amount nor selection rule is imported from that separate identity.

NEW ROLL/ROOT COMPLETION: each successor draw is a distinct original die event, completed and any permitted replacement resolved before that successor is committed and the following candidate set is built. A legal Fate Coin replacement of a visible physical1dN changes this one index using the same original candidate ordering; never rebuild the candidate set to favor its new face. It cannot revisit the same selection after consequences or reroll a hidden die. Actual perception/30feet/LoE and the single Mark Omen/Fate Coin lineage guard remain prerequisites. A digital uniform draw is not automatically eligible for a feature expressly limited to a physical die; record the method and apply that feature's exact interpretation rather than grant new information or authority.

After all legal selections and their roll replacements are final, create the instantaneous cast's recipient damage roots together before the first recipient damage packet: each has the caster as dealer, that caster's actual Veil state at this common checkpoint, its own recipient identity and the same cast lineage. Subsequent pure transfers retain those flags. Independent events later removing a selected recipient can prevent its pending packet but cannot redraw or erase the other already-established roots/arcs. No actualDamageDealt, Wound, death or resource trigger occurs merely because an identity was selected or a root allocated.

AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.status: NEW scoped target predicate for only Greater Air Pet and Faction Army soldier profiles.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01.classification: NEW AC6 scoped same-body full-suppression lifecycle
rule: NEW explicit scope for these three AC6 profiles: while any part of the actual occupied body intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, apply this whole-body suppression lifecycle. Use the field's actual clipped volume and re-evaluate as the body moves or falls.
